caption: Most teams adopt microservices too early. Three signs you actually need them, and what to do if you don't.

slides.say: Most teams adopt microservices too early. Here are three signs you actually need them.
First: teams keep waiting on each other to deploy. One codebase has become a traffic jam.
Second: one part of the system needs far more resources than the rest.
Third: a bug in one feature keeps taking down everything else.
If none of this sounds familiar, a well-structured monolith will take you further. Follow for more.
